header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: far above you); so do not follow (your) desires and abandon doing justice; and if you distort (the testimony), or turn away (from giving testimony), indeed Allah is Aware of what you do.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاِذَا حُيِّيْتُمْ بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوْا بِاَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا اَوْ رُدُّوْهَا ؕ اِنَّ اللهَ كَانَ عَلي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَسِيْبًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: When you are greeted with a greeting (Salam), greet in return with one better than it (with more beautiful words of Salam); or return the same — indeed Allah is a Reckoner over all things.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقاَلَ تَعَالي: (وَقَضَي رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْا اِلَّا اِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَاناً ؕ اِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِنْدَكَ الْكِبَرَ اَحَدُهُمَا اَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُلْ لَّهُمَا اُفٍّ وَّلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُلْ لَّهُمَا قَوْلاً كَرِيْمًا ۞ وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُلْ رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَارَبَّينِيْ صَغِيْرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Your Rabb has decreed that you worship none (no one and nothing else) but Him; and (has decreed) that you do (much) good to your mother and father; if one of them or both of them reach old age with you, do not say “Uff” to them; and do not drive them away; and speak to them only honourable words. And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy! “My Rabb, have mercy on them both as they (tenderly) raised me when I was small!”
